faq.q: What is the origin of Resul?
faq.a: Resul is associated with Arabic. Resul is the Turkish form of Arabic رَسُول (Rasūl), meaning 'messenger'.
Yes — the underlying form رَسُول is Arabic.
Resul can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Resul should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root ر س ل is Quranic (messenger), but Rasūl is not itself a Quranic personal name.
